close_reason: .github/workflows/docker.yml created with build/push and grype vulnerability scan
description:
## Why
stoa-4291i: automated image build/push is the delivery mechanism.

## What
Add docker.yml GitHub Actions workflow:
- Trigger: push to main (SHA tag) and push of semver tags (version + latest)
- Build using the Dockerfile added in the Dockerfile issue
- Push to GHCR (ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }})
- Run grype or docker scout vuln scan; fail on HIGH/CRITICAL CVEs
- Cache layers with actions/cache or buildx inline cache

## Acceptance
- Workflow file exists at .github/workflows/docker.yml
- grype scan step fails build on HIGH/CRITICAL (unacknowledged)
- Image tagged :sha-<SHA> on main push and :v<X.Y.Z> + :latest on tag push
title: CI: build and push OCI image on main + semver tags
